_what: Sharing your Trillion tools to one named person, read only (src/view-as.mjs). The owner keeps a share at their own door with the engine's sharing.keep (trillion-rust src/account_rights/share_grant.rs): a label, the read-only tools the person may run, and the person's bearer digest (a link) or principal. The share's end is the person's own rule (`ends`, {until: ISO}), read by tools/end-a-grant-whose-condition-failed; the days offered here become that rule. Stop is sharing.withdraw. The look sign-in, its cookie and its banner are retired (Nov 20 2026 ruling). `words` are every sentence the screens say.

words.heading: Let someone see your Trillion
words.body: They see your Home exactly as you do, read only: they cannot change, send or delete anything. You are told every time they look, and you can stop it any time.
words.bad_label: The name must be 1 to 400 bytes.
words.bad_tools: Choose at least one tool to share.
words.bad_people: Name at least one person, and no more than 64.
words.bad_identity: Who acts is either none or the person.
words.bad_journal: The journal is either input or none.
words.stop_confirm: Stop sharing your tools with {who}? They lose access at once.
